Enterprise Investment Scheme

Why invest in an EIS
qualifying company?

  • 30% Income Tax ReliefOn the amount you invest, claimed against your Income Tax bill.
  • 0% Capital Gains Tax exemption after 3 yearsGains on qualifying shares held for at least three years are free of Capital Gains Tax.
  • 45% Up to 45% Loss ReliefIf an investment fails, losses can be set against your income at your highest tax rate.

Reliefs depend on your individual circumstances and on the company keeping its EIS status. See tax note*

Capital at risk. Investments in film and television are high risk. You could lose all of the money you invest, and you should not expect to be protected if something goes wrong. These investments may be difficult to sell, and past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results. Nothing on this website is personal advice. If you are unsure whether an investment is right for you, seek independent financial advice.

*Tax relief. Enterprise Investment Scheme (EIS) Income Tax Relief of 30% is available only on investments in companies that meet HMRC's EIS rules, and only if those rules continue to be met. Relief depends on your individual circumstances, may be withdrawn if the company or investor stops qualifying, and tax rules can change. Shares must normally be held for at least three years to keep the relief. Please speak to a tax adviser.

**Projected return. The 217% projected return on investment is a forecast, not a guarantee. It is based on assumptions about future events that may not happen, and actual returns may be much lower. You could lose all of the money you invest. Forecasts are not a reliable indicator of future performance.
